name: Мох — каменная полка
subject: ONE fantasy voxel environment dressing asset. The moss vegetation ITSELF: a thick low L-shaped moss SHELF with two unequal connected arms, stepped emerald and olive moss lobes along the top, intended to cling to a boulder crevice. Shape is vegetation only, not a solid stone shelf. Same shape in all rotations. NO stone, soil, terrain or supporting ground.
caption: Пять ракурсов одного варианта декора. Крупные воксели, чистый фон; без земли и демонстрационной подложки.
prompt_override: Create a BRAND NEW fantasy Minecraft-style voxel asset reference sheet. The supplied image is STYLE ONLY; do not copy its identity or geometry. Exactly FIVE separate complete views of ONE identical asset: front and back on upper row, left profile, right profile and isometric game view on lower row. Large axis-aligned cubes, flat square surfaces and broad coarse pixel material patches. Pure uniform white background, generous margins. NO text, annotations, arrows, panels, labels, ground, dirt, supporting plinth, cast/contact shadows or ambient occlusion. Mild face material color variation only. Subject: A very LOW HORIZONTAL L-shaped moss patch intended to sit in a rock crevice. Two broad unequal arms form an L IN TOP PLAN, not an upside-down L in profile. Entire patch at most TWO geometric cubes tall, with a few broad green block lobes, dark emerald/olive material pixels. FLAT BOTTOM at same height under both arms. Absolutely no hanging green parts, vines, dangling roots, tendrils or vegetation icicles. No rock or other support.
